properties.coordinate_format_original: Decimal degrees; longitude, latitude; explicitly WGS84
properties.coordinate_source: USGS Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS), Deposit ID 10231011, record field “Geographic coordinates”; point of reference: Ore Body; unpaginated electronic record.
properties.host_rock_reported: Mainly sedimentary terrane, late Mesozoic (MRDS wording).
properties.deposit_type_reported: Unknown (MRDS primary mode of origin: UNKNOWN; orebody type: UNKNOWN; shape: TABULAR).
properties.notes: MRDS explicitly prints a WGS84 coordinate and identifies the reference as Ore Body, but reports location accuracy of 10,000 m. Class A means the numeric coordinate is printed directly; it does not mean high positional accuracy. Excluded from MN-001; no record identity linking it to Ab Band I or II was established.

properties.coordinate_format_original: Geographic DMS, longitude then latitude; no hemisphere or datum printed
properties.coordinate_source: Aganj, Karimi & Khankehdani, “تعیین منشاء کانه‌زایی منگنز کوه خم با استفاده از مطالعات بافتی و کانی‌شناسی”, 4th Conference of the Iranian Economic Geology Association (1391/2012), abstract study-location sentence; unpaginated online conference record.
properties.host_rock_reported: Radiolaritic cherts interlayered with the mineralization, associated with the Neyriz ophiolite sequence.
properties.deposit_type_reported: Probable hydrothermal origin; radiolarite-replacement textures are interpreted as diagenetic, with late epigenetic open-space filling reported.
properties.notes: The source prints longitude 54°19′ and latitude 28°53′ and states the locality is 60 km from Estahban. Decimal display is direct DMS arithmetic (54+19/60; 28+53/60); source does not state hemispheres or datum. N/E orientation follows the stated Iranian locality. WGS84 compatibility is therefore approximate and datum is unverified; no projected-coordinate transformation was applied.

properties.coordinate_format_original: Geographic DMS (N/E); datum not stated in the type-locality label
properties.coordinate_source: Khosravi & Poormahdi, “Polygonum khajeh-jamali (Polygonaceae), a new species from Iran”, Annales Botanici Fennici 45(6) (2008), p. 477, type-locality label (“Khajeh-Jamali, chromite mine”); verified in the digitized treatment citing that page.
properties.host_rock_reported: Dunite and harzburgite reported for Khajeh-e-Jamali chromite mines by Moghtaderi et al. (2003); this lithology is not part of the botanical type label.
properties.deposit_type_reported: Alpine-type chromite deposit, as reported for Khajeh-e-Jamali deposits by Moghtaderi et al. (2003).
properties.notes: The source prints 29°48′46″N, 53°51′53.64″E specifically for “Khajeh-Jamali, chromite mine”. Decimal values are direct DMS arithmetic; datum is unstated and no datum transformation is claimed. Mine operating status is not reported. Host-rock and deposit-type descriptions come from a separate Khajeh-Jamali chromite study and are distinguished from the coordinate source.

properties.notes: Direct conversion of the printed DMS values to decimal degrees; Table 1 does not identify datum or CRS, and labels the columns Easting/Northing despite degree notation. Longitude/latitude order is interpreted from the numeric values and the stated Qatruyeh location; WGS84 datum is not verified. The 2014 article states no exploitation activities at that time; current operating status is unknown. This is an ore-sample location within one Qatruyeh study area, not a separate independent deposit or validation label.
